label: Wikidata taxon items for 93 slice taxa, retrieved 2026-10-31
bibliographic_citation: Wikidata contributors (2026-10-31). Wikidata: the free knowledge base. Wikimedia Foundation. Items found by SPARQL on P225 and retrieved via wbgetentities.

distributions.description: wbgetentities for the first 50 chosen QIDs (P225 checked)
wbgetentities for the remaining chosen QIDs (P225 checked)

counts.description: slice taxa with a Wikidata QID (P225 equal to the queried name, except Q536444 Pinna nobilis, see notes)

measurement_technique: SPARQL lookup of items whose taxon name (P225) equals the scientific name; where several items matched, the item with a taxon rank was chosen; P225 then re-checked with wbgetentities.
role: Wikidata identifier for the listed taxa
notes: Q536444 (Pinna nobilis) has P225 'Pinna rudis' on Wikidata but carries this taxon's GBIF (4374731) and NCBI (111169) identifiers.
